data.name: Before the Tee
data.detailed_description:
When does this game release?

Expected release date is Fall 2026!

How can I help?

Join our discord to help with playtesting!  Give us your feedback and share your ideas with us.

About the game

A golf course management tycoon. The golfers play the round, you run the track. Manage the Tee sheet, fix the cart fleet, maintain the greens, handle groups arriving and playing through.  Watch the golfers play your course while putting out fires as they arise!

Can I build my own course?

Yes!  Build your starting course and add or modify as you progress.  Upgrade and purchase amenities to attract more golfers to your course.

Features

Mow the fairways, set the pins, roll the greens, rake the bunkers all before the golfers arrive at the course for the day!  Sit back and watch the golfers take on your course while driving around to fix issues as they arise.  Plan expansions and envision turning your local muni into a country club that rivals the best in the country!

Future Plans

We have dozens of ideas planned, but if you have one you would like to provide join our discord and let us know!

data.short_description: Before the Tee is a top-down golf course management sim. You run the links, not the round. Design the course, set tee times, manage the cart fleet, drive the maintenance cart around to fix issues, and watch groups arrive to play their way through a full day from sunrise to sunset.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Any 64 bit dual-core (2.0 Ghz+)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 and up
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Discrete GPU not needed
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: MacOS 11
  • Processor: Apple Silicon or Intel
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: MacOS 12
  • Processor: Apple M-series or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple GPU / Intel Iris Xe
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
